drafted_from: tools/social-posts/tool-rows.json (tool:list-my-youtube-videos), tools/social-posts/test/youtube-connection.test.mjs and the row's request; the answer is worked out from the row, not observed
start_here: Say to your AI: "List the videos on my YouTube channel, including unlisted and private ones, with their privacy status." It checks the connection for the uploads playlist id, then runs tool:list-my-youtube-videos with it.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads your uploads playlist through your YouTube connection and posts and changes nothing.
instructions: 1. Connect your YouTube account (service_connection:youtube, or service_connection:youtube:<name> for a second one).
2. Run tool:check-the-youtube-connection with {account_id}; it answers the channel and its uploads playlist_id.
3. Say "List my YouTube videos": the AI runs tool:list-my-youtube-videos at @workshop-tools with {account_id, playlist_id}.

4. Read the answer: the playlist's items (50 a page), each with its title, publish time and privacy status (public, unlisted or private), and nextPageToken when there is more; pass it back as page_token for the next page. A refusal from YouTube means the sign-in lacks read access to the channel.

worked_examples.title: The first page of a channel's uploads
worked_examples.ask: List the videos on my YouTube channel with their privacy status.
worked_examples.given: Read from tools/social-posts/tool-rows.json (the row's http request) and test/youtube-connection.test.mjs, not run live: the engine sends GET https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/playlistItems with part=snippet,status,contentDetails, maxResults=50 and playlistId=UUexampleuploads0000000000, the connection's access token in the Authorization header only to www.googleapis.com. The channel (synthetic) has two uploads.
worked_examples.hands_back: YouTube's own answer for that request, unchanged: {"items":[{"snippet":{"title":"Shaping a boule","publishedAt":"2030-11-05T10:00:00Z","resourceId":{"videoId":"vid-aaa"}},"status":{"privacyStatus":"public"},"contentDetails":{"videoId":"vid-aaa"}},{"snippet":{"title":"Draft: scoring tips","publishedAt":"2030-11-06T10:00:00Z","resourceId":{"videoId":"vid-bbb"}},"status":{"privacyStatus":"private"},"contentDetails":{"videoId":"vid-bbb"}}], ...} (each item also carries the snippet's other fields; the example values are synthetic, the fields are the ones the request asks for). With more than 50 videos it also holds nextPageToken.
